name: parking-building-management-api
description: Parking Building Management System — Zone & Gate API

scripts.dev: set DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env&& set DOTENV_CONFIG_OVERRIDE=true&& ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only -r dotenv/config src/app.ts
scripts.db:generate: set DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env&& set DOTENV_CONFIG_OVERRIDE=true&& prisma generate
scripts.db:migrate: set DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env&& set DOTENV_CONFIG_OVERRIDE=true&& prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: set DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env&& set DOTENV_CONFIG_OVERRIDE=true&& ts-node -r dotenv/config prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:studio: set DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env&& set DOTENV_CONFIG_OVERRIDE=true&& prisma studio
